content.en: It’s only been a day since I arrived in Yuntai, but it feels like so much has happened.
content.zh: 来到芸台不过短短一天，总感觉经历了好多事啊。

content.en: The incident on the plane, the monster in the apartment building, and that endless walkway...
content.zh: 飞机上的事件，公寓楼里的怪物，还有那条走不出的步道......

content.en: In this city... something is happening. Threads of it all point toward Troupe Elysium, but it feels like there’s more to it than that.
content.zh: 这座城市里......有什么阴谋正在发生，千丝万缕都指向了那个戏团，但又似乎不止如此。
